sections.heading: 神的诸名（按出现次序）/ The Divine Names in Order of Occurrence

blocks.en: NAMES OF GOD, in order of occurrence mainly. Elohim: Gen. 1:1. In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. Jehovah-Elohim: Gen. 2:7. The Lord God. El: Gen. 14:18. The most high God. Adonai Jehovah: Gen. 15:2. Lord God. El Shaddai: Gen. 17:1. I am the Almighty God. Jehovah, the memorial name: Ex. 3:14, 15. This is My name for ever, and this is My memorial unto all generations. Ex. 6:3. Ex. 15:3. The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is His name. Ex. 34:5-9 (the proclamation of the Name, and its meaning). Special connections of place and event: Gen. 22:14. Jehovah-jireh (the Lord will provide). Ex. 17:15. Jehovah-nissi (the Lord my banner). Judges 6:24. Jehovah-shalom (the Lord send peace). Jehovah of hosts: 1 Sam. 1:3. Ps. 46:7, 11. The Lord of hosts is with us. Jesus Christ the Jehovah of hosts: Isa. 6:1-5. Mine eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts (compare John 12:41). Jah Jehovah: Isa. 26:4. In the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength. Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: Isa. 41:14; 43:14, 15; 44:6; 47:4; 48:17; 49:26; 54:5; 60:16; 63:16. Deut. 7:9. The faithful God.
blocks.zh: 神的名，大体按其出现次序。Elohim（以罗欣）：创世记 1:1 —— 起初神创造天地。Jehovah-Elohim（耶和华以罗欣）：创世记 2:7 —— 耶和华神。El（伊勒）：创世记 14:18 —— 至高的神。Adonai Jehovah（阿多乃耶和华）：创世记 15:2 —— 主耶和华。El Shaddai（伊勒沙代）：创世记 17:1 —— 我是全能的神。Jehovah（耶和华）——那纪念的名：出埃及记 3:14-15 —— 耶和华是我的名，直到永远；这也是我的纪念，直到万代。6:3。15:3 —— 耶和华是战士，他的名是耶和华。34:5-9（宣告这名及其含义）。与特定地点、事件相连的名：创世记 22:14 —— 耶和华以勒（Jehovah-jireh：耶和华必预备）。出埃及记 17:15 —— 耶和华尼西（Jehovah-nissi：耶和华是我旌旗）。士师记 6:24 —— 耶和华沙龙（Jehovah-shalom：耶和华赐平安）。万军之耶和华：撒母耳记上 1:3。诗篇 46:7, 11 —— 万军之耶和华与我们同在。耶稣基督即万军之耶和华：以赛亚书 6:1-5 —— 我眼见大君王万军之耶和华（参约翰福音 12:41）。Jah Jehovah（雅耶和华）：以赛亚书 26:4 —— 因为耶和华是永久的磐石。救赎主，以色列的圣者：以赛亚书 41:14；43:14-15；44:6；47:4；48:17；49:26；54:5；60:16；63:16。申命记 7:9 —— 他是信实的神。

grammar.note: Elohim / El / Adonai / El Shaddai / Jehovah：希伯来神名的同位罗列——El 系诸名侧重能力（Shaddai：全能），Jehovah（YHWH）侧重立约与启示。
Jehovah-jireh / -nissi / -shalom：复合圣名（耶和华以勒／尼西／沙龙），各由一次事件命名，是以色列人『立石为记』式的神学记忆法。

blocks.en: "The Name of God"—the Name represents the Being: Ps. 20:1, 5, 7. The name of the God of Jacob defend thee. In the name of our God we will set up our banners. We will remember the name of the Lord our God. Ps. 30:4. Give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness (His holy memorial name). Ps. 69:30. I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify Him with thanksgiving. Ps. 111:9. Holy and reverend is His name. Prov. 18:10. The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe. Isa. 57:15. Thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy. Dan. 2:20. Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever. Micah 4:5. We will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever. Hence the Third Commandment: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain. The name of Jesus Christ: Matt. 12:21; 28:19. Luke 24:47. John 1:12; 20:31. Acts 2:38; 3:6; 4:12. Phil. 2:9-11. Wherefore God also hath highly exalted Him, and given Him a name which is above every name. Col. 3:17. Prophetic titles of Christ: Isa. 7:14. They shall call His name Immanuel (God with us). Isa. 9:6. His name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace. John 1:1, 14. In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us. Rev. 19:13, 16. His name is called The Word of God. And He hath on His vesture and on His thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
blocks.zh: 『神的名』——名代表存有本身：诗篇 20:1, 5, 7 —— 愿雅各神的名高举你。我们要因你的救恩夸胜，要奉我们神的名竖立旌旗。但我们要提到耶和华我们神的名。30:4 —— 称赞他可记念的圣名（英译：称谢他神圣的纪念之名）。69:30 —— 我要以诗歌赞美神的名，以感谢称他为大。111:9 —— 他的名圣而可畏。箴言 18:10 —— 耶和华的名是坚固台，义人奔入便得安稳。以赛亚书 57:15 —— 因为那至高至上、永远长存（原文作住在永远）、名为圣者的如此说。但以理书 2:20 —— 神的名是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。弥迦书 4:5 —— 我们却永永远远奉耶和华我们神的名而行。故有第三诫：不可妄称耶和华你神的名。耶稣基督的名：马太福音 12:21；28:19。路加福音 24:47。约翰福音 1:12；20:31。使徒行传 2:38；3:6；4:12。腓立比书 2:9-11 —— 所以神将他升为至高，又赐给他那超乎万名之上的名。歌罗西书 3:17。基督的预言性称号：以赛亚书 7:14 —— 给他起名叫以马内利（神与我们同在）。9:6 —— 他名称为奇妙、策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君。约翰福音 1:1, 14 —— 太初有道，道与神同在，道就是神。道成了肉身，住在我们中间。启示录 19:13, 16 —— 他的名称为神之道。在他衣服和大腿上有名写着说：万王之王，万主之主。

grammar.note: Holy and reverend is His name / Blessed be the name of God：表语前置倒装＋祈愿虚拟。
the Name represents the Being：希伯来思想中『名即其人』的原则——本条全部经文的解释钥匙；reverend：可畏的（今作教牧尊称，此处是其古义）。

sections.heading: 格林论『底本说』 / Green on the Documentary Hypothesis

blocks.en: [In Genesis 1:1-2:3 the Most High is constantly called God (Heb. Elohim); but in 2:4-3:24 He is called Lord God (Heb. Jehovah Elohim), and in chapter 4, Lord (Heb. Jehovah). From this it has been inferred that these are by two separate writers, one of whom is in the habit of using the Divine name Elohim, while the other makes use of the Divine name Jehovah; the former of these hypothetical personages is accordingly denominated the Elohist, and the latter the Jehovist. But this assumption is altogether unnecessary. The alternation of these Divine names, both here and elsewhere throughout the Pentateuch, is to be accounted for—not by a diversity of writers, but by a difference in the signification and usage of the names themselves. God made Himself known to the chosen race as Jehovah, the God of revelation and of grace; Elohim is the general term for God in His relation to the world at large and to all mankind. Hence in describing the creation of the world (1:1-2:3), Elohim is the name proper to be used; in 2:4-chapter 4, Jehovah is appropriate, because the theme is the establishment of God's kingdom among men—as shown first in the primeval estate of man, then in the promise of redemption after the fall, and in His dealings with Cain until he went out from the presence of the Lord, the seat of God's revelation. The different diction of chapters 1 and 2 is due, not to diversity of authorship, but to a difference in the subject treated and in the thought to be expressed. Elohim, the God of creation, destroys the work of His own hands because of the perversion of His creatures from the end for which they were made; at the same time He makes provision for the preservation of the various species of animals which He has brought into being. Jehovah, the God of revelation and redemption, puts an end to the downward progress of wickedness, which threatens to thwart His scheme of grace; but He watches over the safety of Noah and his family, and accepts his worship. The Divine names are used throughout in accordance with their proper meaning and their ordinary usage. W. H. Green.]
blocks.zh: 〔在创世记 1:1-2:3 里，至高者一律被称为『神』（希伯来文 Elohim）；但在 2:4-3:24 里，他被称为『耶和华神』（Jehovah Elohim），在第 4 章里则称『耶和华』（Jehovah）。有人据此推断：这些段落出自两位不同的作者之手，其中一位习惯用神名 Elohim，另一位则用神名 Jehovah；于是前一位假想中的人物被命名为『以罗欣典作者』（Elohist），后一位为『耶和华典作者』（Jehovist）。但这一假设全无必要。这些神名的交替使用——无论在此处还是在五经其他各处——都不该以作者之不同来解释，而应以这些名字本身在含义与用法上的差别来解释。神向选民所启示的自己是『耶和华』——启示与恩典之神；而 Elohim 是指神与整个世界、与全人类之关系的通称。因此，在描述世界受造时（1:1-2:3），Elohim 正是当用之名；在 2:4 至第 4 章，Jehovah 才合宜——因为那里的主题是神的国在人间的建立：先见于人原初的境况，再见于堕落后救赎的应许，又见于神对该隐的处置，直到该隐从耶和华面前（即神启示的所在）出去为止。第 1 章与第 2 章用词的不同，并非出于作者之异，而是出于所论主题与所欲表达之思想的不同。Elohim——创造之神——因他的受造之物背离受造的目的而毁灭自己手中的工作；同时他又为所造各类动物的存留作出预备。Jehovah——启示与救赎之神——终止了那威胁要挫败他恩典计划的罪恶下滑之势；但他看顾挪亚一家的安全，也悦纳他的敬拜。这些神名自始至终都是按其本义与惯常用法而使用的。格林（W. H. Green）〕

grammar.note: the Elohist / the Jehovist：底本说（Documentary Hypothesis）的两个假想作者名——格林（普林斯顿）此段是十九世纪末保守派反驳底本说的标准论证：名的交替出于神学功能而非作者之别；hypothetical personages：假想中的人物（带反讽）。
not by a diversity of writers, but by a difference in the signification：not … but … 的解释权之争；参主题词条：圣经批评学（052）。

elohim.def: 希伯来文：神（创造之神的通称，形式为复数）

jehovah.def: 希伯来文 YHWH 的传统读法：耶和华（立约启示之名）

adonai.def: 希伯来文：主（犹太人诵读 YHWH 时的代读词）

shaddai.def: 希伯来文：全能者（El Shaddai：全能的神）

memorial.def: n. 纪念（memorial name：纪念之名）【四级】

hosts.def: n. 万军（Lord of hosts：万军之耶和华）【四级】

reverend.def: adj.【古义】可畏的，当受敬畏的（今为教牧尊称）

pentateuch.def: n. 摩西五经（penta 五＋teuchos 卷）

jehovah-jireh.def: 耶和华以勒：耶和华必预备（创 22:14）

jehovah-nissi.def: 耶和华尼西：耶和华是我旌旗（出 17:15）

jehovah-shalom.def: 耶和华沙龙：耶和华赐平安（士 6:24）

vocab_table.def: 创造之神的通称／立约启示之名（底本说争议的焦点）
